text:
December in Tokyo smells of cinnamon and hot wine 🎄

Five Christmas markets are open in and around the city this year, from a free one in Roppongi to a big harbour-side night in Yokohama. Roppongi Hills' market turns 20 this year.

All five close on 25 December.

Would you go for the Glühwein or the gingerbread? ☕
